messages.subject: CV-7 - internal investigation report (privileged)
messages.plaintextBody:
All,

Attached is our internal investigation report for the board meeting on the 16th. In short: 2,140 affected vehicles (builds 4.2.0-4.2.3), eight field reports, no injuries, root cause understood, fix validated. We recommend (1) immediate DVSA notification and (2) a voluntary recall to deploy build 4.3.0.

Our separate advice note on exposure will follow before the meeting. Please treat as privileged and confidential.

Tom

—
Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
